notes: Sources: one usable file, 2018_01_umfa_ca_2017_2021.txt (UMFA Collective Agreement April 1, 2017 - March 31, 2021; signed 2018; in force on 2018-03-13 per its version note).

The collective agreement is the governing document for tenure-stream faculty (Members: full-time professors, associate and assistant professors, lecturers, instructors and academic librarians), so missing is false (the rule for records with no governing document, reader instructions §3, is not triggered).

Birth-parent chain: maternity leave with allowance 17 [100% salary weeks 1-2 (c2) -> top-up to 100% with EI weeks 3-17 (c3); EI maternity from week 2 (c4)] -> parental leave with allowance 18 [top-up to 95% while on EI parental (c6); EI parental 35 consecutive_after EI maternity (c7)] -> parental leave without allowance 19 (c8; 37-week parental cap, 54-week total cap) -> return-term teaching relief (c11, rest of the term of return). Alternative: maternity leave without allowance 17 (c9) in lieu of c1-c3.

Non-birth-parent chain: parental leave with allowance 18 from the birth (c5) [top-up to 95% from week 2 while on EI parental (c6); EI parental 35 from week 2 (c7)] -> parental leave without allowance 19 (c8; 37-week cap) -> return-term teaching relief (c11).

R21: the agreement's two-week EI waiting-period clauses (s. 22.2.1.4.2) were written for the old two-week wait; on 2018-03-13 the EI wait was one week (EI Act s. 13), so the extra two paid weeks 'if EI has determined that there will be a two-week waiting period' do not apply. The employer's 100% pay for maternity weeks 1-2 applies as written.

U8 / paths: the allowances require EI qualification; the member described is EI-qualified. Other child care leave (s. 22.3, c10) is only for Members not eligible for maternity or parental leave, so it is coded with that group, not the code. Allowances end at the end of a term appointment (term faculty only). Where a Member took maternity leave without allowance and the other parent is a Member qualifying for parental leave with allowance, they may share it (s. 22.2.1.1.1.2).

Other provisions read and not coded as components: pension and benefit contributions continue during the allowance periods; leave counts toward research/study-leave eligibility and vacation; expense-fund allocations and northern allowance continue during maternity/parental leave; Article 29 childcare is a commitment only; tenure is retained during any leave (s. 19.C.3.6); s. 15.2 reasonable accommodation (Human Rights Code) is general; research/study, administrative, political and outside-agency leaves cannot be taken for a birth; pre-retirement half-time appointment (s. 10.18.2) is age-based.

Calendar: the agreement defines a First (Fall) term September 1 - December 31 and a Second (Winter) term January 1 - April 30 (semester calendar) without a length in weeks; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.
